official_task.source_prompt: The video depicts a medical team wearing blue scrubs performing surgery in an operating room. One surgeon is prominently in the foreground, leaning over the patient.
official_task.edit_prompt: Change the blue scrubs to green.
official_task.target_prompt: The video depicts a medical team wearing green scrubs performing surgery in an operating room. One surgeon is prominently in the foreground, leaning over the patient.

events.name: 首次抬头后进入持续向前看的姿态
events.definition: 前景戴花纹帽口罩男子从首帧低头姿态抬头；双眼可见并转入持续数帧向前看的稳定段，取这一转换区间。

events.name: 向前看后再次低头
events.definition: 前景人物从此前稳定平视转回向下，帽顶相对更可见、视线落回画面下方；取转换而非后续最深低头。

events.name: 低头状态下形成向画面右侧转头
events.definition: 在第二个低头阶段之后，前景人物头部进一步转向画面右侧；以相对此前低头姿态明显增加的侧向脸部/口罩朝向为标志。转向渐进，保留较宽边界。
